biggestGap: Focus discipline — nested double focusable trap + overlapping hintbar + no persistent focal halo · expected visionOS exactly one obvious focal element per moment (gaze halo 10px dot + 3px halo + 2.5px stroke-focus + 22px bloom 350ms dwell prism-ease interruptible, others dim to 0.42, single tab per PWA).
